extraction.notes: EQR does not report an AFFO metric; affo fields are null. Core = 'Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units'. ffo_total uses the 'FFO available to Common Shares and Units' subtotal (410,199), after preferred distributions; a separate 'FFO' line of 410,555 appears below it in the same table and is not used as the subtotal. Preferred distributions (-356) sit between net income and the FFO subtotal and are included as 'other'. 'Premium on redemption of Preferred Shares' is '—' for the quarter (0). 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (-24,341) is categorized as 'other' because the filing does not define whether it is real estate or investment related. Diluted shares 390,966 (thousands) reproduce FFO/share 410,199/390,966 = 1.05 and Normalized FFO/share 399,150/390,966 = 1.02. Recurring capex of 135,335 is only disclosed on a nine-month basis (page 26 capex table); no quarterly recurring capex figure appears on these pages.
